column1: # Purpose: declare symlinks into Git dependencies after repository reconciliation.
# Format: source<TAB>target; exactly two non-empty fields separated by one literal TAB.
# source: existing path relative to HOME; directories and files are both allowed.
# target: unique symlink location relative to HOME; its parent directory must exist.
# Paths cannot be absolute or contain empty, . or .. segments, TAB, newline or |.
# A matching symlink is skipped. Conflicting paths or symlinks are never overwritten.
# Link rows run in file order, after every selected repository row.
# Blank lines and lines beginning with # are ignored. No inline comments or quoting.
